mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET reply_content = #{replyContent}, reply_created_at = #{replyCreatedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reviews SET status = #{status}, delete_reason = #{deleteReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE reviews SET rating = COALESCE(#{rating}, rating), content = COALESCE(#{content}, content), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reviews WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId})

SELECT r.id, r.business_id AS "businessId", r.reservation_id AS "reservationId", r.customer_id AS "customerId", r.staff_id AS "staffId", r.customer_name AS "customerName", r.rating, r.content, r.images, r.status, r.reply_content AS "replyContent", r.reply_created_at AS "replyCreatedAt", r.created_at AS "createdAt", b.name AS "businessName", b.slug AS "businessSlug" FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN businesses b ON r.business_id = b.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews r LEFT JOIN customers c ON r.customer_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND reply_content IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reviews WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reviews WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) FROM reviews WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
